en: The front of the postcard shows a sepia-toned photograph of six people, five women and one man (possibly a chef due to his hat), standing in front of a villa-style building with classical columns, a balustraded balcony, and the sign 'Parkschlösschen'. Handwritten notes are present at the bottom. The reverse side features address lines, museum and inventory stamps, the phrase 'Bad Pyrmont', and various handwriting in German.
